Hi Jared / Solanum team,

Thanks for submitting the initial onboarding packet. I pulled the form you uploaded and the finance intake — a couple of gaps we need filled before we can issue a provisional PO: 

- SKU-level descriptions and unit codes (several lines have "TBD").
- Clarify whether line 2 is a one-time setup fee or a recurring monthly charge.
- Vendor bank details missing the beneficiary address block on page 2 (required for USD ACH).

Can you attach a completed onboarding_form_v2 (I included our template) and also confirm the spend cap you want us to provisionally set? Finance typically issues a provisional PO for new vendors between $5k–$50k depending on contract stage; if you need a higher commit we can route an exec approval.

Thanks Jared — the filled spreadsheet looks much better. A couple of notes from procurement/finance side: 

- For a new vendor we can issue a provisional PO up to $25,000 without leadership approval; anything above $25k requires finance + commercial sign-off (usually 48–72h).
- If Line 2 is recurring (monthly), we issue the provisional PO as a one-time initial invoice estimate; recurring billing will be handled via our AP terms and require a contract in place.
- Please provide beneficiary address (ACH) and W-9 (US vendors) to move to PO issuance.

Neha — I can draft the provisional PO request and route it internally once Jared confirms beneficiary address and whether Solanum wants the provisional cap at $15k (as Jared suggested) or $25k. I started a cover memo (po_request_cover.docx) with recommended spend = $15,000 pending SOW acceptance.

Action items: 
- Jared: send beneficiary address + W-9 by EOD Tue.
- Karthik: can you hold a quick approval slot in the procurement queue for this once the docs are in?
